docs.title: VREIT: Declaration of Cash Dividends
docs.text:
Declaration of Cash Dividends - Q4 2025

At the meeting of the Board of Directors of VistaREIT, Inc. (the “Company”) held on 11 May 2026, the Board approved the declaration of Q4 2025 Cash Dividends based on the unrestricted retained earnings of the Company in its unaudited financial statements as of the year ended 2025 and which shall be payable in cash to all its stockholders on the basis of outstanding stocks held by them. Details as follows:Amount : Php 0.03800 per shareRecord Date : 25 May 2026Payment Date : 29 May 2026

As of 29 May 2026, the total dividends paid by the Company shall comprise at least 90% of its distributable income based on its unaudited financial statements as of the year ended 2025. Upon release of its Audited Financial Statements for the year ended 2025 and if necessary, the Company shall declare additional cash dividends to comply with the required dividend distribution under Article II, Section 7 of Republic Act No. 9856.

docs.title: I: Material Information/Transactions
docs.text:
Constitution of Emergency Board

Please be informed that the following officers of I-Remit, Inc. (the “Corporation”) were unanimously elected by the remaining members of the Board of Directors as temporary directors for the purpose of constituting an emergency board pursuant to Section 28 of Republic Act No. 11232 (Revised Corporation Code):Ms. Maria Cristina S. Castillejo – Senior Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer Mr. Severino A. Lagan Jr. – Vice President, Information Technology Group Mr. Juan Angel L. Tinio – Senior Vice President and Chief Risk Officer Mr. Franco C. Monserrat – Assistant Manager - Global MarketingThe emergency board is being constituted to deliberate on and approve the following matters: 1. 2025 Integrated Annual Corporate Governance Report; 2. 2026 Annual Stockholders’ Meeting date to the maximum extension period permitted under the Revised Corporation Code; 3. 2025 Annual Audited Financial Statements upon availability; 4. Acceptance of the Letter of Intent from a prospective investor to be endorsed by Frankfurt Equity Ventures, Inc. 5. Strategic Restructuring, Regulatory Preservation, and Institutional Transformation Framework in collaboration with a prospective local bank recognized for its treasury expertise and transformative initiatives together with a prospective foreign partner also known for its transformative initiatives; and 6. Such other corporate actions as may be necessary for the emergency approval and continued operations of the Board of Directors. The term of the temporary directors shall commence on May 28, 2026, and shall remain effective until June 30, 2026.
